latest_release.name: Fluid Framework v3.12.0 (minor)
latest_release.body: ## Contents - [✨ New Features](#user-content--new-features) - [Add controls to pause inbound operations while staging local changes (#28625)](#user-content-add-controls-to-pause-inbound-operations-while-staging-local-changes-28625) - [🌳 SharedTree DDS Changes](#user-content--sharedtree-dds-changes) - [Array move events now behave consistently before and after hydration (#28487)](#user-content-array-move-events-now-behave-consistently-before-and-after-hydration-28487) - [Manage branch state independently of views (#28520)](#user-content-manage-branch-state-independently-of-views-28520) - [Reduce optimized forest memory overhead after loading and receiving inserted content (#28653)](#user-content-reduce-optimized-forest-memory-overhead-after-loading-and-receiving-inserted-content-28653) - [⚠️ Deprecations](#user-content-️-deprecations) - [Deprecate isEquivalent compatibility flag (#28655)](#user-content-deprecate-isequivalent-compatibility-flag-28655) ## ✨ New Features ### Add controls to pause inbound operations while staging local changes ([#28625](https://github.com/microsoft/FluidFramework/issues/28625)) The beta stage controls expose `pauseInbound()` and `resumeInbound()` to control inbound operation processing without leaving staging mode. Await `pauseInbound()` before relying on inbound processing having stopped. Repeated pause or resume calls are idempotent. Committing or discarding staged changes automatically releases any pause acquired through these controls, even if exiting staging mode throws. Pauses acquired by other code are preserved, and inbound signals are not paused. While paused, the client's reference sequence number does not advance, which holds back the minimum sequence number for all clients. If the container reconnects while paused, it might not finish connecting until inbound processing resumes. Keep pauses short. `pauseInbound` and `resumeInbound` are `undefined` if the container runtime does not support them, for example because it is an older version. Check that they are defined before calling them. ```typescript const controls = containerRuntime.enterStagingMode(); if (controls.pauseInbound !== undefined) { await controls.pauseInbound(); } // ... make staged changes ... controls.commitChanges(); // Or controls.discardChanges(). ``` Use `controls.resumeInbound?.()` to resume inbound operation processing while remaining in staging mode. #### Change details Commit: [`0da51de`](https://github.com/microsoft/FluidFramework/commit/0da51ded6b0b962fb231286c059a9a02af57999e) Affected packages: - @fluidframework/container-runtime - @fluidframework/runtime-definitions [⬆️ Table of contents](#user-content-contents) ## 🌳 SharedTree DDS Changes ### Array move events now behave consistently before and after hydration ([#28487](https://github.com/microsoft/FluidFramework/issues/28487)) Range moves on unhydrated arrays now produce change events and deltas consistent with hydrated arrays, including when the destination is within the source range and the contents remain unchanged. This also makes insertion anchors update consistently before and after hydration. Moving an empty range on unhydrated arrays no longer emits change events, matching hydrated arrays. #### Change details Commit: [`1038bf6`](https://github.com/microsoft/FluidFramework/commit/1038bf6d64d663da816edbe9df299123d7787599) Affected packages: - @fluidframework/tree - fluid-framework [⬆️ Table of contents](#user-content-contents) ### Manage branch state independently of views ([#2
